units.title: The Printing Press
units.blurb: Johannes Gutenberg in Mainz: metal type, oil-based ink and the press, about 1450.

units.title: Leonardo's Notebooks
units.blurb: Leonardo da Vinci: thousands of pages of studies, machines and flying devices.

topics.title: Gutenberg: Movable Type, Ink and the Press
topics.short: In Mainz around 1450, Johannes Gutenberg put together cast metal letters, an oil-based ink and a screw press, and printed a Bible.
topics.trouble: People think Gutenberg invented printing itself; printing from blocks, and movable type in East Asia, came centuries earlier.

topics.title: Leonardo da Vinci: Notebooks and Flying Machines
topics.short: The painter and engineer (1452–1519) filled notebooks with studies of birds, water and machines; most of his designs were never built in his lifetime.
topics.trouble: People think Leonardo built helicopters and tanks; they are drawings and notes, most never built or tested in his day.
